head: codex/5627-csdlc-four-command-lifecycle
title: fix(csdlc-v2): collapse routine lifecycle into four commands
body: Closes #5627. Collapses the routine C-SDLC v2 path into validate, review, publish, and closeout while retaining exact evidence and terminal receipts. Removes nested Cargo builds from the installer CI proof and reuses a verified current installation when possible.
